newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's Finance Ministry names new coordinator.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's Finance Ministry names new coordinator.

text.p: Mexico's Finance Minister on Tuesday named Alejandro Valenzuela as head of the unit of technical coordination and chief spokesman, moving him from his previous post as director general of international affairs.
Valenzuela will still conduct his regular news conference on Wednesday at 2 p.m. (1900 GMT).
In his place as head of international affairs, Finance Minister Guillermo Ortiz named former International Monetary Fund economist Juan Amieva.
